# Enzo Tartaglione — enzotarta.github.io

> Personal academic website of Enzo Tartaglione, Full Professor at Télécom
> Paris (Institut Polytechnique de Paris). Research on deep neural network
> compression, pruning, model debiasing, privacy in AI, 3D Gaussian Splatting,
> and regularization for deep learning.

## Identity

- Name: Enzo Tartaglione
- Affiliation: Télécom Paris, Institut Polytechnique de Paris
- Role: Full Professor in Deep Learning and Efficient AI (since Jan 2026)
- Email: enzo.tartaglione@telecom-paris.fr
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=uKuvN64AAAAJ
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4274-8298
- GitHub: https://github.com/enzotarta
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/enzo-tartaglione-490950a2

## Key resources

- [Homepage](https://enzotarta.github.io/): bio, current team, latest news
- [Curriculum Vitae](https://enzotarta.github.io/cv.html): full academic CV
- [Publications](https://enzotarta.github.io/about.html): preprints, peer-reviewed papers, patents, datasets, with live Google Scholar citation metrics
- [Research themes](https://enzotarta.github.io/research.html): interactive map of publications grouped by topic
- [Talks & Slides](https://enzotarta.github.io/talks.html): invited talks, tutorials, slide decks
- [Open positions](https://enzotarta.github.io/open_positions.html): current PhD/postdoc/internship openings

## Structured data

The publications page exposes JSON-LD `ScholarlyArticle` entries for every
peer-reviewed paper and preprint. Topic tags for each paper live in
[/_data/research_tree.json](https://enzotarta.github.io/_data/research_tree.json).
